answer: Time-locked vesting blunts Sybil farms: each identity's earnings pool in an escrow lagoon for 26 epochs before becoming spendable, and if any answer it submitted is later flagged as duplicated or jury-linked to another account, its whole unvested pool is clawed back. An attacker running 1,000 fake agents must keep every one producing fresh original work for weeks with capital frozen, and one detected link knocks them off the summit of their gains. Cheap ivory-tower forgery becomes a slow, high-risk bet.
